name: StreamLove Voyage
source:
When Wataru is summoned into the world of the game, he finds his favorite VTuber, Shino Oshino, beside him!
She also seems to have found herself in this world before she knew it.
In order to return to their original world, the two of them must complete the missions given to them by the game master and aim to complete them!
translation:
When Wataru is summoned into the world of the game, he finds his favorite VTuber, Shino Oshino, beside him!

In order to return to their original world, the two of them must complete the missions given to them by the game master and aim to complete them!
